title: HBG Distribution Get Well
purpose: The Distribution side of Homebody Guaranty: getting the resident enrolled and re-enrolled on Sign. Application and screening, renewal offers and repricing, transfers, and the lease documents that price the guaranty. Renewals (#2) are the critical path; transfers (#8) are tracked here too but off it. What the policy does after enrollment (charges, cancellations, Leap sync, claims, reporting) is HBG Delivery Get Well. Economics for the line live on Insurance Line Performance.

sections.title: Distribution-side issue categories
rows: Renewals

Not one problem but a program. Auto-enroll with full repricing shipped late September to mid-October with two hotfixes behind it (bulk renewal stopping after one lease; expiration not firing on an ineligible response). A follow-on request tracker already queues repricing on Edit Renewal Offer, refreshing the offer when rent changes, overriding ineligibility blockers, locking carry-forward enrollment, and starting the next policy on the 1st. Bug pattern: false duplicate-enrollment blocks, unenroll leaving charges alive, renewal flows retyping the scheduled charge, pricing discrepancies.

46 issues, 21 open. DEV-343026 (initiative), DEV-287712, DEV-348657 and DEV-349951 (hotfix), DEV-347769 and DEV-348144 (hotfix), DEV-347132 (request tracker), DEV-342483, DEV-347105, DEV-347155, DEV-349176, DEV-347139.
Policies do not auto-renew. Extend the Guarantor Waiver Fee through the renewal term at current pricing before renewing.
Dan Bullock
Transfers
Small in Jira, loud in the room. New policy not created on unit transfer; double billing of transferring residents; fees not showing in renewal transfers. No epic yet (Track 8).
End the old unit's fee in the last month of occupancy, start the new unit's fee at occupancy, no overlap in one month, verify the old policy is inactive in the Leap portal.
Jae Lee
Application and screening
Unauthorized enrollments. Guarantor options not offered. Waiver not appearing in the student application. Screening and application events changing coverage after a policy already exists.
36 issues, 21 open (summary mentions screening, application, or enrollment). DEV-349570, DEV-326349, DEV-349675, DEV-349201, DEV-348851 (epic, New), DEV-311270.
Student proof on file; lease signed more than 60 days before start; one student, at most 2 bed spaces; no overlapping Leap policy; no prior claim payout. Forced-place component available.
Owner to confirm
Lease documents and merge fields
Guaranty merge fields price from the current interval's rent instead of the renewal document's. Blank when the admin fee is $0. Enrollment amount merge field not working.
Leap addendum signed before approval; declarations page uploaded before move-in.
Owner to confirm

items.text: Renewal: the Guarantor Waiver Fee is extended through the end of the renewal term before the renewal is countersigned, at current pricing.
Renewal: no policy renews into month-to-month, including a roll to MTM because move-out was not performed.

items.text: Transfer: the current unit's fee ends in the final month of occupancy.
Transfer: the new unit's fee starts in the first month of occupancy and runs through the new lease term.
Transfer: two fees never post for one resident in one month.

items.text: Transfer: the old policy is confirmed inactive on Leap's side after the transfer.
Application: an active Leap policy on another lease blocks a second enrollment; a non-overlapping future lease does not.
